items.description: One creation asset row — a whole puck.creation.v1 document embedded inline, in canonical form, in the world file with its identity hash pinned beside it. The document and hash must come from the same CanonicalDocument`1: the compose boundary canonicalizes on upsert and rejects a hash the pipeline did not itself compute; the validator re-verifies the pin on every candidate, so a tampered world file rejects loudly. World files stay self-contained — the CAS is an authoring-time import/export cache, never a load-time dependency.

id.description: The row's stable string id — its mutation address and the handle placements reference — authored literally or through a Text state cell.
id.title: DocumentIdentifier

hash.description: The SHA-256 hex64 of the document's canonical bytes (Hash on the canonical result the compose boundary produces). ABSENT resolves to the hash computed from Document at load — an author never writes a content hash by hand; see Hash.

mesh.description: Opaque triangles every static placement of the prototype draws beside its field, or null for none.

vertices.description: The vertex positions, in the author frame.

material.description: The index of the creation palette entry the triangles shade with.

mesh.title: WorldPrototypeMesh

document.description: Gets the creation document as it arrived: normalized when a mutation upserted it (the compose boundary canonicalizes), the author's own bytes when the world loaded it. Consumers read EngineDocument, which is normalized whichever way the row arrived.
document.title: CreationDocument

name.description: The creation's handle, authored literally or through a containing world's Text state cell; normalization narrows a literal value to letters, digits, dashes, and underscores.
name.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
name.title: DocumentIdentifier

palette.description: The material palette (null = the default sweep).

emissive.description: The emissive luminance, in nits, the colour tints (null = 0 — optional members are nullable and normalized at load).

specular.description: The specular strength (null = the material default).

roughness.description: The GGX roughness in [0, 1] (null = DefaultRoughness) — see SdfMaterial for the roughness-floor formula. A document still spelling shininess is an unmapped member and is refused.

sheen.description: The fresnel edge-lift strength in [0, 1] (null = 0 — no lift) — see SdfMaterial.

metal.description: The metalness in [0, 1] (null = 0 — dielectric) — see SdfMaterial.

coat.description: The clearcoat strength in [0, 1] (null = 0 — no coat) — see SdfMaterial.

items.description: One ascending coverage threshold and the surface it reveals.

weathering.description: Optional generic coverage and reveal surfaces.

wrap.description: The wrap-lighting share in [0, 1] (null = 0 — the plain Lambert term) — see Wrap.

soften.description: The shading-normal broadening in [0, 1] (null = 0 — no broadening) — see Soften.

fill.description: The fill tint as #RRGGBB or a state binding (null = black — no fill) — see Fill.

origin.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.

rotation.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.

items.description: One ascending radial ramp stop.

bleed.description: The color multiplying outgoing indirect reflectance and emission, as #RRGGBB or a state binding; null means white.

receive.description: The finite nonnegative gain on received indirect light; null means one.

type.description: The primitive, read as a shape's type: every primitive but a path profile.

color.description: The paint's color, #RRGGBB or a state binding.

position.description: The primitive's position (null = the frame's origin).

scale.description: The primitive's size, as a shape's scale (null = one).

stroke.description: The half-width of the band painted about the primitive's surface, in the frame's units; null or zero fills the primitive.

parent.description: The shape whose frame carries the paint, in that shape's local frame as a shape-riding volume is; null paints in the frame of the slot that owns the hit, or world space on a static placement. A static placement draws no parented paint.

taper.description: Prism only: the top-to-bottom width ratio.

profile.description: Prism only: the cross-section; a path profile is refused.

rounding.description: The edge-rounding radius, as a shape's.

chamfer.description: The cap chamfer radius, as a shape's.

curve.description: Sweep only: the curve, in the frame's units.

items.description: A paint over the palette slot's surface: a primitive of the shape vocabulary, placed like a shape, whose inside (or, with a Stroke, the band within that distance of its surface) takes Color. It never changes the field or the bake; the views pass draws it crisp at the pixel. A plane stroked at a half-width paints a stripe, an extruded ellipse prism stroked paints a ring projected along its axis, and a thin sweep paints a curved line where it crosses the surface.

paints.description: Up to MaxPalettePaints paints, each drawn over the one before; null or empty paints none.

emissiveLane.description: The render lane whose saturated value scales Emissive at shading time: 0 to 3 an inhabited body's own look lanes (a placement without them reads zero), 4 to 7 the world's render.lanes (SdfLanes). Null keeps the emissive static.

depth.description: The thickness, in creation units, over which light takes on the tint; finite and positive. A part twice this thick reads twice as deep.

ior.description: The index of refraction, in [1, 4]: 1 bends and reflects nothing, 1.5 is window glass, 1.49 acrylic (null = 1.5).

scatter.description: The colour the glass scatters as a medium, the colour a deep body of it reads as under the light arriving at its surface (null = none).

scattering.description: How much the medium scatters, per creation unit, finite and non-negative; it also dims what lies behind (null = 0, no scattering).

reach.description: The distance, in creation units along the view from the glass surface to the opaque surface behind it, over which the added coverage falls to zero; positive.

coverage.description: The coverage added where the opaque surface touches the glass's, in [0, 1].

contact.description: Foam or a wet margin where an opaque surface behind the glass comes within reach of its surface, revealed through the slot's flow coverage (null = none).

shadowDensity.description: Shadow extinction per creation unit, finite and non-negative (null = zero).

glass.description: The slot's glass (PaletteGlassDocument), whose tint is Color and whose frost is Roughness; null keeps the slot opaque.

toon.description: The slot's own cel style (ToonStyleDocument, on unless it says enabled: false, which keeps the slot continuous); null shades the slot with the world's default style (render.toon).

state.description: The state.<row>[.<key>] binding naming the cell.

items.description: A cel style on the wire (SdfToon): the world's default style (render.toon, which the live world.toon lever overrides) and a palette row's own (Toon) are this one shape, so a style authored once (the standard's styles.puck) serves both. The engine holds no look of its own: a style that bands authors every value, and one that says enabled: false needs none. Presentation only; no field enters simulation state or the bake.

cases.description: The styles, the first for the value zero; each is a whole style (ToonStyleDocument), enabled: false keeping the slot continuous.

toonSelect.description: The slot's styles chosen live by a state cell (PaletteToonSelectDocument), whose case replaces Toon while the cell names one; null keeps Toon.

velocity.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
velocity.description: The flow, in units per second.

scale.description: The pattern's frequency, in cells per unit; positive (null = 1).

stretch.description: How many times longer a pattern feature is along the flow than across; at least 1 (null = 1).

cycle.description: The seconds a layer advects before it restarts, in [0.25, 4096] (null = 1).

tilt.description: The normal tilt per unit slope of the pattern; non-negative (null = 0).

coverage.description: The share of the slot the pattern reveals Surface over, in [0, 1] (null = 0).

surface.description: The surface the coverage reveals; required when Coverage is positive.

lane.description: The render lane whose value scales the velocity: 0 to 3 an inhabited body's look lanes (a placement without them reads zero and stands still), 4 to 7 the world's render.lanes (SdfLanes). Null keeps the velocity constant.

frame.description: The frame the velocity is authored in (null = Object).

x-enumDescriptions.Object: The frame of the surface's own object: the creation's frame for a placed creation (its copies turn the vector with them), the slot's frame for a surface riding a slot, and world space for a surface emitted in world space (a field row).
x-enumDescriptions.World: World space whatever the surface rides, the pattern included, so it runs continuously across every surface wearing the material: a wind across a meadow of separately swaying blades.

coverageLane.description: The render lane, as Lane, whose value saturated to [0, 1] scales Coverage. Null keeps the coverage constant.

center.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.

radius.description: Radius in world units over which the velocity blends back to the base, finite and positive.

velocity.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
velocity.description: Velocity at the centre in the flow's velocity frame, before placement scaling.

region.description: A sphere in world coordinates within which the velocity varies.

flow.description: The slot's flow layer (PaletteFlowDocument): shading that moves along an authored flow over still geometry; null moves nothing.

items.description: A runtime slot's type and initial data. Names bind source references and do not enter program identity.
An output expression; omitted outputs retain the stage's default.
A dependency-ordered value in the canonical document. Reads may name only earlier values of this phase.

shade.description: The authored presentation program and runtime parameters.

items.description: One palette entry on the wire (mirrors SdfMaterial with document-doctrine nullability).

The persisted form of a placed shape. Position and Rotation are authored in the creation's author frame — see CreationFrame — and Scale is the primitive's size directly: see CreationGeometry's unit table.

name.description: The frame's name (rest is the live pose).

id.description: The shape id the snapshot belongs to.

position.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.

rotation.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.

items.description: One shape's rigid pose inside a timeline frame. A frame carries no scale: a frame pose rides the shape's dynamic slot, which holds a position and an orientation, while a shape's scale is baked into its geometry.

transforms.description: The per-shape transform snapshots, keyed by shape id.

items.description: One timeline frame on the wire: a named full snapshot of every shape's transform. Part of the hold-style animation timeline — authored frames replayed with no interpolation.

chains.description: The IK rig's chains (null = none). Shapes stay flat; a chain only references shape ids.

shapes.description: The member shape ids, root→tip order.

kind.description: KindLimb or KindSpine (null = limb when exactly 3 shapes, else spine).

goal.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
goal.description: The live goal position (null = the rest tip — re-seeded at load).

pole.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
pole.description: The bend-direction hint (null = above the root — re-seeded at load).

items.description: One IK chain on the wire. Carries no rest geometry (joint pivots, bone lengths) of its own — a chain consumer derives that from the member shapes' current positions; only the goal/pole live pose and the member list persist here.

cameras.description: The creation's anchored camera eyes (null = none). Each rides a shape and produces a named feed — the lantern-fish's lure lens is one entry here.

id.description: The eye's stable id within the creation.

shapeId.description: The anchored shape id (a Id). A camera naming a missing shape is dropped at load (its offset frame has no anchor).

position.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
position.description: The eye offset from the anchored shape's frame origin, in the creation's author frame (see CreationFrame).

fov.description: The vertical field of view, degrees (null = the engine default).

feed.description: The named feed this eye publishes (null = the eye's id as a name). A screen face wired to this name shows this eye's live render — pure data, no creature-specific channel.

items.description: One camera eye a creation carries — a posed viewpoint anchored to one of the creation's own shapes (a Id), so the eye rides that shape's live pose through IK/animation frames. This is the creation-side twin of a world document's placed camera: the lantern-fish's lens dangling off its lure becomes one entry here rather than a hardcoded engine. The offset pose (position/yaw/pitch) is relative to the anchored shape's frame; the feed it produces is wired onto a screen by name through the creation's behavior manifest (see CreationBehaviorDocument) or a world's wiring table.

behavior.description: The behavior manifest (null = the defaults: walks, no face). Records how the creation moves and any screen faces it declares, so consumers stop re-supplying those facts by hand.

locomotion.description: How the creation moves, as a free-text token a consuming world resolves as a kit name: a creation declaring swim inhabits the world's kit row named swim when a placement's inhabit facet omits an explicit kit (a world declaring no such kit rejects the placement loudly, naming every kit it declares). It is not a closed enum — the runtime answer to "how does it move" is the resolved WorldKit.Model, never this string parsed per frame. Null = walk.

faces.description: The declared screen faces (null = none). A creation with a face shows a feed on its body; the face's default source is pure data, wirable to any camera feed.

name.description: The face's name (a wiring handle — face by default).

shapeId.description: The shape whose surface is the screen (a Id; -1/null = the whole creation's canonical face surface, resolved by the consumer).

defaultSource.description: The feed this face shows when nothing else is wired, as a source token a consuming world resolves through a closed four-token map — none (unbound glass), test (the test pattern), and camera:<name> / feed:<name> (a View of the named camera, resolved against the placement's derived creation-eye feeds then the world's own camera rows). An unrecognized token (including a bare named:emotes, which named a host registry no world provides) shows unbound glass. Null = unbound glass until a world's face override wires a feed.

items.description: One screen face a creation declares — a surface on the creation (backed by one of its shapes) that shows a feed: by default the source it names (a host feed such as emotes), and wirable to any camera feed (a creation camera's named feed, another creation's feed, a world camera) purely by naming a different default source. No feature-specific channel exists — a face is just a screen surface with a default wire, and the wiring model does the rest.

sounds.description: The declared sounds (null = none). Omitted from the wire when null, so a creation authored without this member serializes to unchanged bytes.

name.description: The sound's name (a wiring handle — sound by default; unique within the creation).

shapeId.description: The shape the voice emits from (a Id; null = the creation's root). A sound naming a missing shape is dropped at load (the post-edit-deletion self-heal, mirroring faces).

patch.description: The voice's puck.synthesizer-patch.v1 patch, inline (validated through the synth family's own canonicalizer as part of creation validation).

radius.description: The audible support radius in world units (null = the consuming world's default speaker radius).

items.description: One sound a creation carries — a creature/phenomenon voice as data, following CreationFaceDocument's named-wiring shape: a name (the wiring handle), an optional anchoring shape the voice emits from (null = the creation's root), and the puck.synthesizer-patch.v1 patch inline — creations stay portable, and the existing creation hash covers the voice with no new pin machinery. A world placement of a sound-bearing creation auto-surfaces an audio emitter anchored to the placement (root or the named shape); the placement row's own emission facet remains the per-instance override channel.

reducedRateAtDistance.description: Whether a placed copy of the creation may animate at the update-rate lever's reduced tiers (world.rates bodies: at least 30 or 15 updates a second) while it stands small on every view that may see it. Null or false = full rate wherever anything may show or read it; a copy nothing may show holds either way. A body-rooted creation takes the reduced tiers whatever this says.

behavior.title: CreationBehaviorDocument

textRuns.description: The engraved/embossed text runs the creation carries (null/empty = none). Each is a string laid onto a surface, expanded at emission into Glyph shapes — see TextRunDocument. Omitted from the wire when null, so a creation authored without this member serializes to unchanged bytes.

text.description: The run's text (whitespace / unmapped code points advance the pen without a glyph).

position.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
position.description: The run's anchor centre on the host surface (workbench space).

rotation.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
rotation.description: The run plane's orientation (local +X advance, +Y ascent, +Z the relief normal).

emHeight.description: The world height of one em, in the creation's own (pre-placement) units.

depth.description: The glyph extrude half-depth — the relief the slab straddles the surface by (null = DefaultDepth).

mode.description: engrave (Subtraction — a carved recess) or emboss (Union — proud relief); null = emboss.

material.description: The palette slot the letters shade with (null = 0).

font.description: The world text catalog font name; null selects that catalog's default font.

maxWidth.description: The greedy word wrap width, in the creation's own units (null = only explicit line feeds break lines). Must be positive when present.

align.description: left, center, or right — how lines position against the block's widest line (null = left).

tracking.description: Extra advance after every glyph, in em units (null = 0; negative tightens).

lineSpacing.description: A multiplier on the font's line height for the baseline step between lines (null = 1).

shapeId.description: The shape the run rides, or null for a run placed in creation space. A riding run's Position/Rotation are in that shape's unit-local frame: scaled by the shape's scale, then rotated and translated with it, so the run stays on the surface as the shape resizes.

items.description: One engraved/embossed text run a creation carries — a string laid onto one of the creation's own surfaces (a shop facade, a marquee band), stored as text-plus-placement and expanded at world-emission time into Glyph shapes via the shared font atlas + Puck.Text.TextLayout (never persisted pre-expanded, so the run stays font-independent on the wire). The run sits on its own plane (Position centre + Rotation, in the creation's workbench space: local +X = advance, +Y = ascent, +Z = the relief normal). The glyph slab straddles the host surface, so the lettering is proud (emboss / Union) or recessed (engrave / Subtraction) but never coplanar — coincident zero-sets speckle (docs/rendering/sdf/reference/text-and-glyphs.md). Position/Rotation are authored in the creation's author frame (see CreationFrame).

parts.description: The authored part identities this creation publishes when used as an entity look (null = none). Each maps a stable identifier to one shape's dynamic transform.

id.description: The ordinal, case-sensitive identifier an entity-part anchor names.

shapeId.description: The stable Id whose dynamic pose the part publishes.

items.description: One authored entity-part identity exported by a creation look.

noise.description: The creation-level noise-relief facet (null = none) — see CreationNoiseDocument. Omitted from the wire when null, so a creation authored without it serializes to unchanged bytes.

frequency.description: The base lattice frequency, cells per creation unit (clamped to (0, MaxFrequency]).

amplitude.description: The peak displacement in creation units, scaled with the stamp (clamped to (0, MaxAmplitude]; zero drops the facet).

octaves.description: The fBm octave count (null = 4; clamped to 1..MaxNoiseOctaves).

gain.description: The per-octave amplitude factor (null = 0.5; clamped to [MinGain, MaxGain]).

lacunarity.description: The per-octave frequency factor (null = 2; clamped to [MinLacunarity, MaxLacunarity]).

seed.description: The hash seed folded into every lattice corner (null = 0).

masks.description: The regions that scale the relief's displacement down (null = none), in authored order: each entry's weight multiplies the relief, so a basin, a pad or a path stands where its shapes put it (CreationReliefMaskDocument).

items.description: The persisted form of a placed shape. Position and Rotation are authored in the creation's author frame — see CreationFrame — and Scale is the primitive's size directly: see CreationGeometry's unit table.

shapes.description: The region's shapes, at least one: geometry only (type, name, pose, scale, exponent, rounding, chamfer, elongate, a prism's profile and lift), of a type contact admits.

fade.description: The band's width, in creation units, above zero.

start.description: Where the band starts, as a distance in creation units from the region's surface; negative starts it inside the region (null = 0).

inside.description: The weight on and inside the region, in [0, 1] (null = 0).

outside.description: The weight past the band, in [0, 1] (null = 1).

items.description: One region of a creation's relief mask (Masks): shapes in the creation's frame, joined by hard union, whose distance m sets a weight inside + (outside − inside)·smoothstep(start, start + fade, m) on the relief's displacement. The shapes only measure distance to the region: they add no surface, take no material and never join the composed solid, and the same field reaches drawing and contact (EmitNoise). With Inside zero the relief is exactly zero on and inside the region, so a carve or pad that is its own region keeps its authored surface; a band at least 9/8 · amplitude · |outside − inside| wide opens no hidden pocket under a thin carved floor.

noise.title: CreationNoiseDocument

drivers.description: The named animation drivers (null = none), at most MaxDrivers — see CreationDriverDocument. A shape's Swings/Slides name one of these. Presentation-only, like the facets that read them.

name.description: The driver's name, unique within the creation — the spelling a facet's driver member resolves against.

signal.description: One of SignalPlanarTravel, SignalTravel, SignalTime, SignalSpeed, SignalVerticalSpeed, SignalTurnRate, SignalTravelDirection, SignalLateralAcceleration, SignalForwardAcceleration, a state cell (state.<row>[.<key>], whose numeric value at the frame's tick is the phase times the cadence), or a SignalDriverPrefix earlier driver. The first three integrate: φ accumulates Cadence × the signal's per-frame delta while w > 0, and wraps modulo 2π so a wheel spins forever without losing precision. The rest are instantaneous: φ is set to Cadence × the current value (through Dynamics when one is named), so a facet reading them tracks rather than cycles.

cadence.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
cadence.description: The signal-to-phase gain: radians per metre for the travel signals, radians per second for SignalTime, radians per metre-per-second for SignalSpeed/SignalVerticalSpeed, radians per radian-per-second for SignalTurnRate, radians per radian for SignalTravelDirection, and radians per metre-per-second-squared for the acceleration signals. Magnitude at most MaxCadence.

when.description: The gate: every token must hold for the driver's weight to ease toward 1 (it eases toward 0 otherwise, using the authored blend times or WeightSeconds by default, so a limb returns to rest instead of freezing mid-stride). Authored as one token or an array of them — a bare string reads as a one-token gate and canonicalizes to the array form. A token is a Puck.Physics.Motion.BodyFacts member name, WhenAlways, TokenMoving, or TokenStill; null is ungated. At most MaxGateTokens. A token no consumer can resolve gates the driver permanently off.

blendInSeconds.description: The exponential time constant in seconds the weight rises over (the gate opening, or a WeightBy level climbing); null uses WeightSeconds. Finite and non-negative; zero applies immediately on the next positive frame delta.

blendOutSeconds.description: The exponential time constant in seconds the weight falls over (the gate releasing, or a WeightBy level dropping), on the same terms as BlendInSeconds. Independent release timing lets a mechanism settle after a quick body response.

dynamics.description: The containing world's dynamics row (natural frequency, damping, initial response) an instantaneous signal's phase follows through, or null to track the signal exactly. A hip that trails a turn and overshoots as it settles, a lean that builds and relaxes, and a pose that eases toward a new level are one signal read through a second-order response. Refused on an integrating signal and on a SignalDriverPrefix signal, whose phase is a running cycle rather than a level; the world validator refuses a name its dynamics section does not declare.

cadenceBy.description: Scales Cadence each frame by a curve of an earlier driver's phase, or null to keep it fixed. A stride on planar travel that takes its radians per metre from a curve of the body's speed lengthens its stride as the body speeds up, so its step rate rises less than its speed does.

weightBy.description: Sets the level the weight eases toward while the gate holds, from a curve of an earlier driver's phase clamped to [0, 1], or null for 1. Two drivers reading one stride's phase through SignalDriverPrefix, one weighted by a falling curve of speed and one by a rising one, cross-fade a walk into a run without their legs ever leaving step.

items.description: One named animation driver a creation declares: a scalar signal read off the body the creation is stamped on, times a cadence, gated by a conjunction of condition tokens. A driver yields a phase φ and an eased weight w ∈ [0, 1]; a shape's ShapeSwingDocument/ShapeSlideDocument facets name a driver and turn (φ, w) into a rotation or a translation. Three composable parts — driver (signal + gate), waveform, joint — cover a walker's limbs, a wheel, a rotor, a tail, and a bobbing hull without any of them being named in engine code.

effectors.description: The inverse-kinematics effectors (null = none), at most MaxEffectors — see CreationEffectorDocument. Each corrects a chain of this creation's own shapes so its tip reaches a target, composing after the drivers and the parent chain. Presentation-only, like the drivers.

name.description: The effector's name, unique within the creation — what a read-back or a refusal spells.

chain.description: The bones, root→tip, each the Name of a shape that DESCENDS from the one before it through Parent. A bone's joint is the pivot of its first Swings entry, or its authored Joint when it swings nothing. Two bones (MinChainBones) solve analytically; three or more — a tail, a tentacle, a spider leg with a coxa — solve by cyclic coordinate descent over Iterations sweeps. At most MaxChainBones.

tip.description: The Name of the shape whose posed origin IS the end effector — the last bone itself, or a shape descending from it (a boot under a shin, a claw under a tarsus).

kind.description: One of KindSurface, KindBody, or KindState.

direction.description: KindSurface: the probe direction in the creation's author frame (see CreationFrame), so it turns with the body — [0, -1, 0] is "below the body", which on a wall-held body points at the wall's own down. Normalized at canonicalization; zero names no direction and is refused.

reach.description: KindSurface: how far along Direction the probe searches, in creation units: world units at the body's scale of one, and multiplied by its scale, as its shapes are. Beyond MaxReach, or at zero or less, is refused. A probe that finds nothing eases the correction out rather than reaching at nothing.

standoff.description: KindSurface: how far off the hit surface, along its normal, the tip is placed, in creation units as Reach is (null = 0 — the tip lands on the surface). The thickness of a boot's sole or the gap a claw keeps.

index.description: KindBody: the population entity index whose root pose is the target.

offset.description: KindBody: the offset from that body's root, in the creation's author frame (null = its root exactly).

reference.description: KindState: a state.<row>[.<key>] reference to a text cell spelling a world-space [x, y, z], read at the frame's tick — a target a rule, a console write, or another system publishes. The containing world refuses a row it does not declare.

target.description: Where the tip is asked to be.

when.description: The gate, in the same vocabulary and with the same easing a driver's When uses: the correction blends in while every token holds and back out otherwise, so a released effector returns the limb to its driver-posed pose instead of dropping it.

weight.description: A constant ceiling on the correction, in [0, 1] (null = 1 — full correction). Multiplied by the gate's eased weight, so a half-weight effector suggests rather than commands.

driver.description: The Name whose wrapped phase the window is read against.

window.$comment: Converter-defined value. This schema supplies documentation but leaves value validation to the creation document loader.
window.description: The phase interval [from, to] in radians, each in [0, 2π). A window whose from exceeds its to wraps through 0 — the half-cycle straddling the phase origin is as authorable as any other.

swingWeight.description: The target influence outside the plant window while the driver is active, in [0, 1]. Null means 1 (continue following the target); 0 releases the tip to its authored swing. As the driver eases to rest, target influence returns to 1 so an idle limb can settle onto its surface.

distance.description: The drift that starts a step, in creation units (world units at the body's scale of one, multiplied by its scale), in (0, MaxDistance].

seconds.description: The step's duration, seconds, in (0, MaxSeconds].

height.description: The arc's peak lift, in creation units as Distance is, in [0, MaxHeight].

replant.description: The stepping latch the tip keeps while Driver is at rest (null = none, and a resting tip follows its target every frame) — see CreationReplantDocument.

plant.description: The contact latch (null = none) — see CreationPlantDocument.

align.description: How much of the tip's tilt the contact takes out, in [0, 1] (null = 0: the tip keeps whatever orientation the solved chain hands it). At 1 the tip's rest orientation is re-aligned to the contact normal: the tip axis that points against the target's probe Direction at rest (creation up for a target that names none) turns onto the surface normal at the target, latched with the plant, or onto world up when the target reports no surface. The turn is the shortest one, about the tip's own origin, so the tip stays on its target and keeps the heading the chain gave it. It is weighted by the eased weight the goal blends by, so a tip a plant releases to its swing (SwingWeight 0) keeps its authored swing off the ground. A boot whose sole is flat at rest keeps it flat when the chain bends to reach a target off its rest offset, and a Standoff equal to the tip origin's rest height then puts the whole sole on the surface.

items.description: One inverse-kinematics effector a creation declares: a chain of its own shapes, root→tip, whose driver-posed pose is corrected so the tip reaches a target. The solve composes after the drivers and the parent chain and bends the pose they produced; it never starts from a rest or default pose. Presentation-only, on exactly the terms ShapeSwingDocument is: the correction composes onto the per-frame dynamic transforms in Puck.World.Client.WorldCreationInstances and nothing else reads it, so the emitted SDF program, the analytic colliders, the compiled solid field, and every simulation value are blind to it.

volumes.description: The bounded participating volumes (null = none), at most MaxVolumes — see VolumeDocument. Each rides the creation root's or a named shape's dynamic slot; a static placement bakes its frame in. Presentation-only: no distance field, no collider.

items.description: One local-density emission ramp stop.

A bounded participating medium carried beside a creation's shapes. Its parent names a shape frame, or null for the creation root. Ramp is evaluated against local density before ray integration. Disabled volumes are omitted by static and animated emission. Cloud volumes use Width as noise-cell size; Coverage and Softness control their density threshold and transition width. Scatter, in [0, 1], is the share of the medium's extinction that scatters the light-casting bodies' light toward the eye; absent scatters none. Axis, Spread, Fade, NoiseScale and NoiseDepth are flow-only controls: a flow's Width is its radius at the mouth, Spread its radius at the far end as a share of Width (absent, zero: the column tapers to a point), Fade the power of the remaining axial share its density falls by (absent, one: linearly to nothing), NoiseScale its noise-cell size in creation units (absent, Width), and NoiseDepth, in [0, 1], the share of its density the noise modulates (absent, one: all of it). Intensity is the luminance, in nits per unit of path, the ramp's colour emits at full density: a ray crossing a unit of a fully dense, unabsorbing medium of white colour gains that luminance.

sizeBy.description: Optional numeric state binding (state.row[.key]) whose authority value, clamped to [0, 1], uniformly scales the creation about its origin. Zero hides it and removes contact. A solid draws the exact size contact sampled before body motion, published with that tick's snapshot; presentation easing never drives contact.
